request.style: English, solemn solo male baritone, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft percussion, somber and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The king gave his command to the governor
Hand the prophet over to the city walls
With Joash the son of the crown
Keep the man behind the bars

[Pre-Chorus]
Say thus says the king to the prisoner
Put this man in prison for his words
Give him only meager rations of bread
And water until I return safely

[Chorus]
The word of the Lord cannot be bound
Though the governor keeps the door locked tight
No prison can hold the truth of God
The prophecy stands before the king

[Verse]
Someone drew his bow at random aim
Struck the king between the sections of armor
Turn around and get me out of the fight
For I am wounded and dying now

[Pre-Chorus]
The battle grew fierce that very day
The king was propped up in his chariot
Facing the Arameans in the dust
That evening he died in the blood

[Chorus]
The word of the Lord cannot be bound
Though the governor keeps the door locked tight
No prison can hold the truth of God
The prophecy stands before the king

[Bridge]
A cry spread through the army at sunset
Every man to his own city and land
The king died and was brought to Samaria
And they buried him in the ground

[Outro]
The meager rations could not save him
The word of the Lord came true
